chapter: Reel 2: Los Angeles musicians, the Apex and Cotton Club
title: Why they called him Mr. Paul
summary: Collette asks about another trumpeter named Paul; Howard says he is the only Paul and everyone called him Mr. Paul.

story.theme_name: How I got my name: nicknames and band monikers
story.community_name: How I got my name: nicknames and band names

blocks.x: Also, what about same other fellow (inaudible).
What about the other trumpet player, dark fellow, Paul something?
Yeah, but a trumpet player named Paul.
Yeah, with Red Mac. In fact, he worked with Gee fee Johnson.
I don't know him. Don't know nobody named my name.
Yeah, Mr. -- that's what they did, they always used to call me Mr. Paul. I don't know why they did that.
Not too many get Mr. on the first name.
